bag.button: On-screen button that opens the player's inventory bag. Noun 'bag' (inventory), not a shopping bag. '(B)' is the keyboard shortcut: keep the letter B.
bag.empty: Shown inside the bag panel when it holds no items: 'The bag is empty'.
bag.hint: Footer hint in the bag panel. Clicking a seed bag starts sowing mode. 'B / Esc' are keyboard keys (keep them); 'đóng' = close the panel.
bag.row_block: One row in the bag panel for a block item. {0} = block material name (e.g. 'Dirt'), {1} = quantity. '×' means quantity, keep it.
bag.row_produce: One row in the bag panel. 'Nông sản' = harvested produce (the crop's yield), not farming in general. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = quantity.
bag.row_seeds: One row in the bag panel. 'Túi hạt' = seed bag (an item holding the seeds of one crop type). {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = number of seeds.
bag.title: Title of the bag (inventory) panel. Noun 'Bag'.
creature.ability_harvest: Lowercase name of a creature's work ability, inserted into creature.working / creature.moving_to. 'thu hoạch' = harvesting (picking ripe crops).
creature.ability_haul: Lowercase name of a creature's work ability, inserted into creature.working / creature.moving_to. 'vận chuyển' = hauling: carrying harvested goods to storage, not 'transport' as a vehicle.
creature.ability_sow: Lowercase name of a creature's work ability, inserted into creature.working / creature.moving_to. 'gieo' = sowing (putting seeds into a tilled plot).
creature.ability_till: Lowercase name of a creature's work ability, inserted into creature.working / creature.moving_to. 'xới' = tilling (hoeing soil to make a farm plot).
creature.ability_water: Lowercase name of a creature's work ability, inserted into creature.working / creature.moving_to. 'tưới' = watering (the action), not the noun 'water'.
creature.head: Start of a creature's status line shown above it. {0} = species id from game data (e.g. 'L1'). Keep the ' · ' separator and the trailing space: the status text follows directly.
creature.idle: Status after the creature's name: the creature has no task right now. Adjective 'idle', not 'free of charge' or 'free time'.
creature.moving: Status after the creature's name: the creature is walking (not to any task). Not the command 'go!'.
creature.moving_to: Status after the creature's name: walking to its next task. {0} = lowercase ability name (e.g. 'sow'). The arrow means 'heading to', keep it.
creature.reason_no_ability: Status after the creature's name: it is stuck because it lacks the ability the next task needs. Short label.
creature.reason_no_path: Status after the creature's name: it is stuck because there is no path to the target. Short label.
creature.reason_no_seeds: Status after the creature's name: it is stuck because there are no seeds left to sow. Short label.
creature.reason_storage_full: Status after the creature's name: it is stuck because storage is full. 'kho' = storage (building), not 'dry'.
creature.working: Status after the creature's name while working. {0} = lowercase ability name (e.g. 'till'), {1} = progress as a whole number; '%' follows.
crop.name: Display name of a crop type. {0} = crop id from game data (e.g. 'A'), so 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'. 'Cây' = crop/plant, not 'tree' or 'stick'.
edit.camera_placed: Message after the player places the observation camera (a camera that lets the player view the world from that spot). {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
edit.collect_none: Result of the Collect action (key F): no dropped items nearby. 'Thu' = Collect (pick up), not 'autumn' or 'receive'. 'vật rơi' = dropped items lying on the ground. {0} = a distance in cells (one decimal at most, e.g. 8 or 2.5).
edit.collect_ok: Result of the Collect action (key F). {0} = number of stacks of dropped items picked up. 'Thu' = Collect, not 'autumn'.
edit.dig_fail: Result message: digging failed. 'Đào' = Dig. {0} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30), {1} = reason (one of the edit.explain_* strings, lowercase).
edit.dig_ok: Result message: digging succeeded and one item dropped. {0} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30), {1} = block material name (e.g. 'Dirt').
edit.explain_no_material: Reason inserted after 'Place ...: failed —'. The bag has none of the selected block type. Mentions keys: F, right mouse button, 1–4, Alt + mouse wheel (keep key names). Lowercase start.
edit.explain_not_attached: Reason inserted after 'Place ...: failed —': a block must be placed next to a solid block. Lowercase start.
edit.explain_not_diggable: Reason inserted after 'Dig ...: failed —': the cell is empty air, water, bedrock ('đá đáy') or a story block (blocks reserved for the story, cannot be changed). Lowercase start.
edit.explain_not_empty: Reason inserted after 'Place ...: failed —': the target cell already has a block. Lowercase start.
edit.explain_not_placeable: Reason inserted after 'Place ...: failed —': this item type cannot be placed as a block. Lowercase start.
edit.explain_occupied: Reason inserted after 'Place ...: failed —': the cell is taken (by a character/creature), or dropped items in it have no room to be pushed up. Lowercase start.
edit.explain_out_of_bounds: Reason inserted after 'Dig/Place ...: failed —': the cell is outside the map. Lowercase start.
edit.mark: Result message after right-clicking soil in Till mode: the cell is marked for creatures to till. {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
edit.open_plot: Result message: the panel of a farm plot was opened. 'Mở' = open (a panel), 'ruộng' = farm plot. {0} = plot number.
edit.open_stock: Result message: the storage panel was opened. 'Kho' = storage, not 'dry'.
edit.pick: Result message after picking up dropped items. 'Nhặt' = picked up. {0} = item label with quantity, e.g. 'Dirt × 3'.
edit.place_fail: Result message: placing a block failed. 'Đặt' = place (a block), not 'order' or 'book'. {0} = block material name, {1} = reason (one of the edit.explain_* strings, lowercase).
edit.place_ok: Result message: a block was placed. 'Đặt' = placed, not 'ordered'. {0} = block material name (e.g. 'Dirt'), {1} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30).
edit.stock_far: Result message: the storage is out of the player's reach, so its panel does not open. 'Kho' = storage. {0} = a distance in cells (one decimal at most, e.g. 8 or 2.5).
edit.till_invalid: Result message: tilling not possible here. 'Xới' = Till. Explains the rule: only the top face of a dirt/grass cell, with empty space above, inside the farm area ('vùng trại'). {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
farm.harvest: Message after the player harvests a plot. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = produce gained, {2} = seeds gained. 'nông sản' = harvested produce.
farm.hud_produce: HUD line: produce in the bag. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = quantity.
farm.hud_seeds: HUD line: seed bag in the bag. Starts with a line break (keep it). 'Túi hạt' = seed bag. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = number of seeds.
farm.hud_sow: HUD line while in sowing mode. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = seeds left. 'Esc / Tab' are keyboard keys; 'thoát' = exit the mode.
farm.hud_tilling: HUD line while the player tills a cell by hand. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30), {1} = seconds elapsed, {2} = total seconds.
farm.hud_walking: HUD line while the player walks to a cell to till it. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30).
farm.rain_cooldown: Message: the player's Rain ability ('Mưa', makes rain to water a cell) is not ready yet. {0} = seconds remaining.
farm.rain_far: Message: the target is out of reach of the Rain ability ('Mưa'). {0} = a distance in cells (one decimal at most, e.g. 8 or 2.5).
farm.rain_grassed: Message: Rain ('Mưa') fell on a dirt cell and it turned into grass. {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
farm.rain_hud_cooldown: HUD line: Rain ability ('Mưa'), key R, is cooling down. {0} = seconds remaining. Keep 'R'.
farm.rain_no_effect: Message: Rain ('Mưa') did nothing. Explains: it only works on a farm plot waiting to be watered, or a dirt cell with empty space above.
farm.rain_ready: HUD line: Rain ability ('Mưa'), key R, is ready to use. Keep 'R'.
farm.rain_watered: Message: Rain ('Mưa') watered a farm plot cell. {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
farm.sow_exit: Message: the player left sowing mode ('chế độ gieo' = the mode where clicking tilled plots sows seeds).
farm.sow_far: Message: sowing failed, target out of reach. 'Gieo' = Sow. {0} = a distance in cells (one decimal at most, e.g. 8 or 2.5).
farm.sow_has_crop: Message: sowing failed, the cell already has a crop. 'Cây' = crop, not 'tree'.
farm.sow_last: Appended to farm.sow_ok when the last seed was used: no seeds left, sowing mode ends. Starts with ' · ' separator (keep it).
farm.sow_no_plot: Message: sowing failed. Seeds can only be sown into a tilled farm plot ('ô ruộng').
farm.sow_no_seeds: Message: sowing failed, the bag has no seeds of this crop. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A').
farm.sow_not_tilled: Message: sowing failed, the cell has not finished being tilled.
farm.sow_ok: Message: seeds sown. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = cell coordinates like (12, 5, 30).
farm.sow_other: Message: this plot is waiting for a different crop to be sown. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A').
farm.till_cancel: Message: the player cancelled tilling by hand ('Tự xới' = till it yourself, instead of waiting for creatures).
farm.till_done: Message: the player finished tilling a cell by hand. {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
farm.till_done_by_other: Message: hand tilling stopped because the cell was already tilled (by a creature). 'Tự xới' = till it yourself.
farm.till_fly_off: Message: hand tilling needs fly camera turned off first. 'F3' is the key that toggles fly camera, keep it.
farm.till_need_player: Message: hand tilling needs the player character to exist in the world.
farm.till_not_needed: Message: this cell does not need tilling.
farm.till_walking: Message: hand tilling started, the player is walking to the cell. {0} = cell coordinates, written like (12, 5, 30).
farm.unreachable: Message: the player character cannot reach this cell (no path).
hud.aimed_drop: HUD line about what is under the mouse cursor: right-click picks up these dropped items. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = item label with quantity, e.g. 'Dirt × 3'.
hud.aimed_harvest: HUD line about what is under the mouse cursor: right-click harvests this crop. Starts with a line break (keep it). {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A').
hud.bag: HUD label before the list of block counts in the bag. Noun 'Bag'. Keep the trailing space.
hud.bag_item: One HUD entry in the bag list. {0} = slot number (1–4, the key to select it), {1} = block material name, {2} = quantity. Keep the trailing spaces.
hud.bag_sel: Same as hud.bag_item but for the selected slot. Keep the rich-text tags …, the brackets and the trailing spaces. {0} = slot number, {1} = material name, {2} = quantity.
hud.camera_help: HUD help line while holding the observation camera item. Right-click on a block places a camera 2 cells above it, facing the current view direction (placing again moves it). 'V' or the 'View camera' button switches view / back. While viewing: hold middle mouse button to rotate. Keep key names. Ends with a line break.
hud.elevation: HUD line: camera viewing angle. {0} = angle in degrees with sign. Explains 0° = level with the sea horizon, + looking up, - looking down. Ends with a line break.
hud.fps: Developer HUD line. F1 / F2 keys pick 30 / 60 FPS. {0} = target FPS, {1} = measured FPS, {2} = simulation tick number ('nhịp').
hud.held: Appended to the HUD mode line: the item currently held in hand. Starts with ' · '. Keep the rich-text tags. {0} = held item name. 'Tab' switches the held item, 'Esc' drops it from hand.
hud.held_camera: Name of a held item: the observation camera (a camera the player places in the world to view from that spot). Shown inside hud.held.
hud.help_fly: HUD help line in fly-camera mode. Right mouse button does the current mode's action within {0} cells of the character, instantly. F collects dropped items within {1} cells. Mentions keys 1–4, Alt + mouse wheel, WASD, Q/E, middle mouse, F3 (keep all key names). Starts with ' · ', ends with a line break.
hud.help_idle: HUD help line when there is no player character. Mode keys are disabled. Mentions keys Tab, 1–4, Alt + mouse wheel, WASD, Q/E, middle mouse (keep key names). Starts with ' · ', ends with a line break.
hud.help_walk: HUD help line while walking. Left click: walk to the clicked spot (hold to follow the cursor). Right click: do the mode's action / harvest / open storage / pick up — target chosen within {0} cells, the character walks to within {1} cells then acts. F collects dropped items within {2} cells. Keep all key names (A, Shift, F, Tab, B, 1–4, Alt, Space, X, F3). Starts with ' · ', ends with a line break.
hud.mode: HUD line: current action mode (decides what right-click does). {0} = mode name (one of hud.mode_*). Keep rich-text tags. Keys: D default, Q dig, E till, R water (keep the letters).
hud.mode_default: Name of the default action mode, inserted into hud.mode. Adjective/noun 'Default'.
hud.mode_dig: Name of the Dig action mode, inserted into hud.mode. Verb as a mode name: 'Dig'.
hud.mode_rain: Name of the watering action mode, inserted into hud.mode: 'Water (Rain)'. 'Tưới' = to water (verb used as mode name); 'Mưa' = Rain, the ability used.
hud.mode_till: Name of the Till action mode, inserted into hud.mode. 'Xới' = till (hoe soil).
hud.rebuild: Developer HUD line (performance). Starts with a line break. {0} = number of chunks rebuilt, {1}/{2}/{3} = time in ms for meshing, writing, physics bake. 'chunk', 'mesh', 'bake' are technical terms.
hud.seed_bag_a: HUD line: seeds in the starter seed bag 'Cây A' (Crop A). Starts with a line break. {0} = number of seeds.
hud.till_help: HUD help line in Till mode. Right-click: on dirt/grass = mark for tilling; on a marker sign ('biển' = farming marker sign, NOT 'sea') = walk there and till by hand; on a farm plot = choose seeds. Left click on a plot: open its panel (with an Unmark button). K: storage. Ends with a line break.
item.dirt: Block material name: dirt (soil). Lowercase in source; the game capitalises it when it starts a label.
item.drop_label: Label floating over dropped items on the ground. {0} = item name, {1} = quantity. '×' means quantity, keep it.
item.grass: Block material name: grass (a grass-covered dirt block). Lowercase in source.
item.sand: Block material name: sand. Lowercase in source.
item.seed_bag_a: Item name: the starter seed bag of crop A. 'Túi hạt' = seed bag, 'Cây A' = Crop A.
item.seed_bag_n: Item name: a seed bag of another crop type. {0} = crop number.
item.stone: Block material name: stone (rock block). 'đá' = stone, not 'kick' or 'ice'. Lowercase in source.
map.close: Button on the full-screen map: close it. '(M)' is the keyboard shortcut, keep 'M'.
map.hint: Hint on the full-screen map: mouse wheel / two-finger pinch zooms; drag pans; M / Esc / Close button closes. Keep key names.
observe.button_back: Button while looking through the observation camera: return to the normal view. '(V)' is the shortcut, keep 'V'.
observe.button_view: Button: look through the placed observation camera. '(V)' is the shortcut, keep 'V'.
observe.loading: Centered text while the observation camera view is loading.
plot.close: Button in the farm plot panel: close it. '(Esc)' is the shortcut, keep 'Esc'.
plot.empty: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': nothing planted. Adjective 'empty', not 'drum'.
plot.grow: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': the crop is growing. {0} = growth percent (whole number); '%' follows.
plot.head: Start of a plot status line. 'Ruộng' = farm plot. {0} = plot number. Keep ' · ' and the trailing space: the status follows.
plot.queue: Column title in the plot panel: the queue of crops waiting to be planted in this plot. Noun 'Queue'.
plot.removed: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': the plot was removed (unmarked). Adjective/past participle.
plot.resume: Button in the plot panel: resume the paused work in progress. Verb 'Resume'.
plot.ripe: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': the crop is ripe, ready to harvest. Adjective 'ripe'; 'chín' is NOT the number nine here.
plot.seed_title: Title of the seed list in the plot panel. Noun 'Seeds' (crop types to choose).
plot.self_till: Button in the plot panel: till this plot yourself (the player character walks there and tills by hand) instead of waiting for creatures.
plot.sow: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': waiting to be sown / being sown. Lowercase, verb/noun 'sow(ing)'.
plot.till: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': waiting to be tilled / being tilled. Lowercase.
plot.till_tile: Label in the plot panel's 'Working' slot when the current work is tilling (no crop yet). Capitalised 'Till(ing)'.
plot.unmark: Button in the plot panel: remove the tilling mark from this plot. Verb 'Unmark'.
plot.water: Plot status after 'Plot N · ': waiting to be watered / being watered. Verb/noun 'water(ing)', lowercase.
plot.working: Column title in the plot panel: the job currently in progress. 'Đang làm' = 'In progress', not 'Working hours'.
settings.button: On-screen button that opens the Settings panel. '(O)' is the shortcut, keep 'O'.
settings.camera_default: Button in Settings: reset camera distance and pitch to defaults.
settings.camera_distance: Settings slider label: camera distance from the character. {0} = value (one decimal).
settings.camera_pitch: Settings slider label: camera downward tilt angle. {0} = degrees (whole number); '°' follows.
settings.close: Button in the Settings panel: close it. '(Esc)' is the shortcut, keep 'Esc'.
settings.export: Button in Settings: export the original (Vietnamese) language file to the game's language folder, so players can translate it. 'gốc' = original/source.
settings.exported: Message after exporting the language file. {0} = full file path.
settings.fps: Settings label: target frames per second (FPS). Keep 'FPS'.
settings.invert_y: Settings toggle: invert the vertical mouse/look axis. Short checkbox label.
settings.lang_dir: Settings info line: where language files are. {0} = folder path.
settings.lang_error: Settings error line (in red): a language file could not be read, so the game falls back to Vietnamese. {0} = language id / file name.
settings.language: Settings label for the language dropdown. Noun 'Language'.
settings.look_sensitivity: Settings slider label: mouse look (rotate) speed. {0} = value (two decimals).
settings.title: Title of the Settings panel. Noun 'Settings'.
settings.ui_scale: Settings slider label: text/UI size multiplier. {0} = scale factor (two decimals), shown after '×'.
site.progress_empty: Progress label on a farm plot in the world: nothing planted. Adjective 'Empty', not 'drum'.
site.progress_grow: Progress label on a farm plot in the world: growing. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = percent (whole number); '%' follows.
site.progress_harvest: Progress label on a farm plot: being harvested. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = percent; '%' follows.
site.progress_removed: Progress label on a farm plot: the plot was removed (unmarked). Past participle 'Removed'.
site.progress_sow: Progress label on a farm plot: being sown. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = percent; '%' follows.
site.progress_till: Progress label on a farm plot: being tilled. {0} = percent; '%' follows.
site.progress_till_paused: Progress label on a farm plot: tilling paused. {0} = percent; '%' follows. 'tạm dừng' = paused.
site.progress_water: Progress label on a farm plot: being watered. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = percent; '%' follows.
site.stock_head: Header of the shared storage summary ('Kho chung' = all storages combined). {0} = used capacity, {1} = total capacity.
site.stock_line: One line of the shared storage summary. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {1} = produce count, {2} = seed count.
site.storage: Label above a storage building in the world. 'Kho' = storage. {0} = produce, {1} = seeds, {2} = used capacity, {3} = total capacity.
stock.bag_none: Storage panel message: the bag has none of this item to move. {0} = item kind ('produce' or 'seeds', from stock.kind_*), {1} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A').
stock.button: On-screen button that opens the storage panel. 'Kho' = storage, not 'dry'. '(K)' is the shortcut, keep 'K'.
stock.dest_bag: Destination name inserted into stock.moved: the player's bag. Lowercase noun.
stock.dest_stock: Destination name inserted into stock.moved: storage. Lowercase noun, 'kho' = storage, not 'dry'.
stock.full: Storage panel message: storage is full, nothing moved.
stock.hint: Hint in the storage panel: each click moves 1; Shift + click moves all. Keep 'Shift'.
stock.kind_produce: Item kind inserted into storage messages: harvested produce. Lowercase noun.
stock.kind_seeds: Item kind inserted into storage messages: seeds. Lowercase noun; 'hạt' = seeds, not 'grain' or 'bead'.
stock.line: One line in the storage panel. {0} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'); 'kho' part: {1} = produce, {2} = seeds in storage; 'túi' (bag) part: {3} = produce, {4} = seeds in the bag.
stock.moved: Storage panel message after moving items. {0} = quantity, {1} = item kind (stock.kind_*), {2} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A'), {3} = destination (stock.dest_bag or stock.dest_stock). Arrow = 'to'.
stock.none: Storage panel message: storage has none of this item. {0} = item kind (stock.kind_*), {1} = crop display name from crop.name (e.g. 'Cây A' = 'Crop A').
stock.produce_to_bag: Button in the storage panel: move produce from storage to the bag. Arrow = 'to'.
stock.produce_to_stock: Button in the storage panel: move produce from the bag to storage. Arrow = 'to'.
stock.seeds_to_bag: Button in the storage panel: move seeds from storage to the bag. 'Hạt' = seeds. Arrow = 'to'.
stock.seeds_to_stock: Button in the storage panel: move seeds from the bag to storage. 'Hạt' = seeds. Arrow = 'to'.
stock.too_far: Storage panel message: move closer to the storage to transfer items. {0} = a distance in cells (one decimal at most, e.g. 8 or 2.5).
time.current: Time dial panel: the current part of the day. {0} = period name (one of time.period_*).
time.hint: Hint on the time dial panel: pick a time landmark to jump to. 'T / Esc' close it, keep the keys.
time.landmark_dawn: Button on the time dial: jump to dawn. Noun, the moment of sunrise.
time.landmark_dusk: Button on the time dial: jump to dusk. Noun, the moment of sunset.
time.landmark_midnight: Button on the time dial: jump to midnight. Noun.
time.landmark_noon: Button on the time dial: jump to noon. Noun.
time.period_dawn: Name of a part of the day, inserted into time.current: dawn (early morning period).
time.period_day: Name of a part of the day, inserted into time.current: daytime.
time.period_dusk: Name of a part of the day, inserted into time.current: dusk (evening period).
time.period_night: Name of a part of the day, inserted into time.current: night.
